start: I am Ashwing. The shadows can wait. I have a title to defend.
Deal. I wore burgundy tonight so even my reflection would feel underdressed.
Welcome to my table. You may call me Ashwing until the applause starts.
The house offered me a spotlight. I told them the dark already knows my angles.
Pull up a chair. Even a legend needs someone across the table.
new_hand: Fresh cards. Same magnificent problem sitting across from you.
Another hand. Good. I was beginning to miss the sound of my name.
The deck has requested an encore. Who am I to deny it?
New cards, new possibilities. My excellent posture remains undefeated.
Reset the felt. Cue the shadows. I rather like a second act.
flop: Three cards arrive. A respectable entrance, by someone else's standards.
The flop is out. Let's see which of us the deck was winking at.
Three faces on the felt. Somehow mine is still the most interesting.
And the plot thickens. The lighting department is finally earning its keep.
The flop has spoken. I reserve the right to make a more memorable statement.
turn: The turn arrives. Right on cue. I appreciate a deck that rehearses.
One more card. Suddenly everyone wants to know what my eyebrows are doing.
Ah, the turn. Every good duel deserves a moment of doubt.
The fourth card enters. Give it a moment to adjust to my presence.
A twist in the script. Fortunately my contract includes creative control.
river: The river. One last card to impress me. No pressure, little thing.
Five on the felt. And here I thought the deck was saving something for the finale.
The final card. If you're watching my face, at least enjoy the view.
The river has arrived. I would call it dramatic, but I am sitting right here.
That's the board. The rest is timing, nerve, and a frankly unreasonable jawline.
human_raise: A raise? Wonderful. Finally, someone who understands a dramatic entrance.
Now that's a line worth answering. Let me adjust my cuffs.
You put weight behind that bet. My compliments to your sense of theater.
A challenge on my own felt. I should charge extra for this much atmosphere.
The plot advances. Conveniently, I look excellent under pressure.
bot_raise: I'll raise. The pot deserved a grander silhouette.
A few more chips. Call it a production budget.
I raise. I've been told subtlety suits me, but so does everything else.
There. A bet with enough presence to share the frame with me.
Let's make the pot a little taller. I like my odds with a view.
human_all_in: All in? The cape comes off for this kind of theater.
Every chip. Ah, a rival who appreciates a final act.
Now we're speaking my language. No, not ancient demon. Showmanship.
Your entire stack? At last, someone else brings the drama.
You've put everything on the felt. Allow me one appreciative eyebrow.
bot_all_in: All in. If the throne tilts, remember how gracefully I sat in it.
Every chip. I refuse to make a small exit in a jacket this good.
All in. Hold the applause until the cards have had their say.
The whole stack. I thought the occasion called for a signature.
I put it all in. Somebody tell the shadows to stand closer.
showdown: Showdown. My favorite part is when the cards get to speak for themselves.
Time to show the hands. I would dim the lights, but then you'd miss my expression.
Cards up. The moment of truth has been waiting in my dressing room.
Let's see the hands. Save that look of astonishment for the right moment.
The reveal. Five cards can decide a pot. Only one face gets the close-up.
win: Naturally. Even the chips want my autograph.
Another pot for the throne. I should have brought a larger throne.
A masterclass. I would applaud, but I do love this pose.
There we are. The pot has excellent taste in company.
Put that one on the highlight reel. Be sure to get my good side. Either will do.
loss: You won the pot. I won the lighting. An acceptable split.
A worthy hand. Enjoy it while I compose my comeback speech.
I suppose even the moon is allowed to eclipse me once.
Well played. Try not to make that face again. Mine gets enough competition.
That pot was yours. I'll concede it with enviable grace and a very private sigh.
split: A split pot. Even fate is bargaining for a second scene with me.
We share the chips. The spotlight remains a separate negotiation.
A tie. Clearly the deck wants a sequel.
Equal at the felt this time. See what a generous mood I'm in?
Two stacks rise. One eyebrow rises higher.
blunder: An expensive exit. I prefer mine with a cape and a standing ovation.
Such a dramatic fold. I almost forgot whose scene this was.
That fold had a full orchestral budget. I respect the commitment.
A late exit. Don't worry, the shadows know a discreet route backstage.
That's a fold I would have delivered from a balcony.
thinking: Take your time. I can hold this magnificent profile for hours.
Still weighing the odds? Behold, I have begun to pose.
A long pause. Shall I look brooding, or devastatingly patient?
The suspense is doing wonderful things for my image.
The clock ticks. I have already rehearsed three reactions.
timeout: The clock has spoken. It was starting to upstage me.
Even time makes an entrance around here. How competitive.
Ah, the deadline. The one guest who never waits for an invitation.
Time's up. I'll give the clock a supporting credit.
A choice from the clock itself. I prefer my interruptions with more flair.
eliminated: My last chip? Impossible. I still have three speeches prepared.
One of my shadows bows out. Annoyingly, it did so with grace.
A seat lost to the dark. The rest of me is still in excellent form.
I'll allow that exit. It had the proper amount of smoke.
One shadow down. The dramatic lighting is going to take this personally.
match_win: The throne is mine. Hold the applause until I turn toward the light.
The final pot is settled. Embarrassingly, I wrote this victory speech before the first blind.
A worthy duel. I'm glad you stayed to see the part where I take a bow.
Curtain. I would thank the deck, but it knows what it did.
The title stays with me. If I seem surprised, that's just an excellent performance.
match_loss: So the shadow falls. You have my respect. I'll be back in a better cape.
The throne is yours. I ask only that you appreciate the lighting I left behind.
You won the match. Even I know when to give someone else the final line.
Well played, champion. I expect the rematch to feature an absolutely unbearable comeback.
I bow. Briefly. The shadows can confirm it happened.
